attributes.review_note: Imported from the FEBRA ATL export by scripts/febra-to-seed.mjs. Facts (id, price, validity, data) are the export’s; ar/ckb text is the export’s own prompt copy, not a translation. NO subscribe/unsubscribe steps were written — the export carries none, and inventing a shortcode is exactly how the placeholder seed went wrong. Still needed before status:verified: how_to, aliases from real logs, the minutes/SMS split (on-net vs all-networks is ambiguous in the source), kmr text, and a docs/21 native review. ⚠ validity_days read from the description, not the validity column ⚠ data_mb left blank — the bundle is unlimited and its GB figure is the fair-use threshold, not an allowance ⚠ no kmr name in the export — machine translation deliberately NOT substituted (docs/21)
